senses.gloss: lujjati (MIndic), ˚jyati, ˚te (= Pali lujjati; not recorded in Pkt. Sheth or Ratnach.; = Skt. rujyate; see also pra-lu˚, vi-lu˚), is broken: ˚jyamānaṃ Mv 〔ii.356.9〕 (vs; v.l. pra-lu˚) = 〔iii.280.15〕 (vs; here Senart lujja˚ with v.l.); lujjanti, v.l. lujyanti (pres. pple. loc.; Senart em. ˚te) Mv 〔ii.371.3〕; lujjamānaṃ, v.l. lujy˚, 〔ii.371.13, 17〕, and repeated below; lujje (aor.) 〔ii.412.11〕; lujyata iti lokaḥ (etymologizing) Mvy 〔3061〕; lujyante AsP 〔256.7〕. See lugna.
